description: This file contains the implementation of the Replayer class for Android Surface rendering, including methods for replaying surface transactions, creating and deleting surfaces and displays, injecting VSync events, and handling manual control commands.

classes.name: Replayer
classes.description: Class responsible for replaying surface transactions, creating surfaces/displays, injecting VSync, and handling manual replay commands.

methods.name: replay
methods.description: Main method to start the replay process, handling event dispatching and synchronization.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a specific trace increment based on its type, spawning threads for surface transactions, display management, VSync injection, etc.

methods.name: createSurfaceControl
methods.description: Creates a new surface control based on trace data.

methods.name: deleteDisplay
methods.description: Deletes a display based on trace data.

methods.name: updatePowerMode
methods.description: Updates the power mode of a display.

methods.name: waitUntilTimestamp
methods.description: Pauses execution until the specified timestamp.
